heroSlides.headline: NGINDA WARRIORS FC
heroSlides.tagline: One Team. One Community. One Warrior Spirit.
heroSlides.description: Established in 2024 to unite our community through competitive football, discipline, youth empowerment, and sporting excellence.

clubInfo.aboutSummary: Nginda Warriors FC is a community-rooted football club established in 2024, built on discipline, competitive ambition, and local pride.
clubInfo.historyNarrative: Founded in 2024, Nginda Warriors FC was established to provide structured, competitive football opportunities for local talent while bringing together supporters, families, and businesses under the Warrior spirit. Additional historical milestones are published here as approved by club leadership.
clubInfo.visionStatement: To become a model community football institution recognized for sporting excellence, youth talent development, and transparent governance.
clubInfo.missionStatement: To nurture football talent, compete with honour and discipline in every fixture, and strengthen community bonds through sport.

coreValues.title: Financial & Operational Transparency

clubInfo.homeGroundDescription: Official home ground details and matchday visitor guidance are managed and published by club administration.
clubInfo.trainingGroundDescription: Training session schedules and ground locations are updated by the technical bench through the Control Centre.
clubInfo.communityImpactSummary: Nginda Warriors FC invests in grassroots football development, youth mentorship, and community cohesion through organized sport.
developmentObjectives: Provide structured coaching and safe training environments for emerging local footballers.
Compete with distinction in regional and national football competitions.
Build sustainable commercial partnerships with local and national businesses.
Maintain transparent financial stewardship for all club development initiatives.
